verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a tax portal with a professional space and e-invoicing services, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only navigation links and service titles (online payment, form search, CFE direct debit), and none of them documents acting on many items at once. Automatic direct debit is a recurring payment arrangement, not a bulk operation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
